column1: # Word's own rendering of nested-tables.docx, as the place every mark of it landed.
# Written by `cargo xtask compare`. Not by hand, and not read by anything
# but the comparison. In points, one mark to a line, of two kinds:
#   mark  page  x0  y0  x1  y1
# Stale? `cargo xtask compare --refresh` renews it, and needs Word for that
# one document. Everything else goes on working without it.
